reason: I won't put a startup with no SOC 2 report and no customers in our order path, and a free six-month pilot doesn't change that because the proxy still sits in front of every trade. Also, no regulator has written a rule that requires agent passports yet, so I'd be budgeting for a control nobody is enforcing.
objection: A proxy in front of our order flow is a single point of failure and a new vendor risk. With no SOC 2, no customers and AINRA as the only identity standard, I'd be the one explaining it to our examiners and our auditors.
would_change_my_mind: A completed SOC 2 Type II report, plus a written rule or enforcement action from a regulator that makes agent identity and approval controls an explicit expectation for venues like ours.
